acceptancePolicy: A_MAIN aggregate 75-90 percent; target near 80 percent; N1/N2 excluded from balance; not a per-build 50-percent requirement; direction/default risks reported, not silently pooled into A_MAIN

candidateMetadata.purpose: Single V3 ratio substitution in captured post-19.2 real generator; no runtime override

canonicalizationPolicy: Only slots and availableOnSlots arrays are semantic sets
durationPolicy: Completed battles only; rounds/actions/turns are not seconds
inferencePolicy: Mirrors and ratio versions are dependent; logical pair indices are the inference unit
seedPolicy: root + caseId*1000 + pair; shared seeds across ratios and mirrored orders; coefficient may change search evaluation count and subsequent generation random draw positions
selectionPolicy: Among A_MAIN aggregate WIN fractions in [0.75,0.90], nearest 0.80; ties nearest 0.92, then lower ratio. Freeze choice before independent-seed confirmation
serviceCaveat: One shared generator/Battle path; actual SAFE/FALLBACK service routes tested separately
skillEventPolicy: Event counts by source side, skill and kind, not unique activations
timeoutPolicy: TIMEOUT is not LOSS; incomplete pairs excluded from paired scores
